display_name: Test: Ops second step on a lock
description: Test of the second step on any lock (S8c, feature A25): a PC and a locker that send a request to a pestered owner, an archive that needs a number matched on a held phone, a safe that wants a code from a borrowed device, a card door and an NPC-opened door that ask Moira, a cabinet whose owner never passes, and a briefcase Gordon hands over. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove a right first factor alone opens no gated lock, a push opens it for a pestered owner, a number must be matched on a held phone, a code is read from a held device, a door and a carried item ask the step too, and no answer shows a code, a number or the contents early
